interactions.effect_en: Raises INR (warfarin works more strongly), with a risk of bleeding.
interactions.effect_zh: 會令INR（凝血指數）升高，即係華法林藥力變強，有出血風險。
interactions.why_en: Danshen thins the blood a little on its own. It also slows down how fast your liver clears warfarin, and frees up more active warfarin in your blood. Together, these make warfarin work more strongly.
interactions.why_zh: 丹參本身有輕微「薄血」作用；亦會減慢肝臟分解華法林嘅速度，同埋令血液入面有效嘅華法林增加。兩樣加埋，華法林藥力就會變強。
interactions.why_pro_en: Three mechanisms: (1) intrinsic anti-platelet activity of danshen; (2) tanshinones inhibit CYP2C9 and CYP1A2, reducing warfarin metabolism; (3) tanshinone IIA displaces warfarin from albumin, raising the free (unbound) warfarin fraction.
interactions.action_en: Avoid this combination where possible. If it cannot be avoided, clotting (INR) tests 2–3 times a week. Tell your doctor that you take danshen.
interactions.action_zh: 盡量避免同時服用。如果無法避免，每星期要驗2至3次凝血指數（INR）。請話俾醫生知你有食丹參。

sources.label: Yu, Chan & Sanderson. J Intern Med 1997
Izzat et al. Ann Thorac Surg 1998
South China Morning Post, 27 Sep 2026 (Hospital Authority rating)

interactions.effect_en: INR more than doubled in a case report (warfarin worked much more strongly).
interactions.effect_zh: 有病例報告指，INR（凝血指數）升高超過一倍（華法林藥力大增）。
interactions.why_en: Dong quai contains natural substances similar to warfarin (coumarin-like compounds). Its ferulic acid also thins the blood.
interactions.why_zh: 當歸含有類似華法林嘅天然成分（香豆素類物質），而入面嘅阿魏酸亦有「薄血」作用。
interactions.why_pro_en: Contains coumarin-like constituents that may add to warfarin's anticoagulant effect; ferulic acid has anti-platelet activity.
interactions.action_en: Avoid this combination. Ask your doctor about an INR (clotting) test.
interactions.action_zh: 避免同時服用。問醫生需唔需要驗INR（凝血指數）。

interactions.effect_en: Lowers warfarin's effect (INR goes down), so there is a risk of blood clots.
interactions.effect_zh: 會減弱華法林藥力（INR下降），有血栓（血塊）風險。
interactions.why_en: American ginseng may make your body break down warfarin faster, so warfarin works less well.
interactions.why_zh: 花旗參可能令身體加快分解華法林，令華法林效果變差。
interactions.why_pro_en: Ginsenosides may induce CYP3A4, speeding up warfarin metabolism. In a human trial of 20 volunteers, American ginseng reduced warfarin's effect on INR.
interactions.action_en: Tell your doctor that you take American ginseng. An INR (clotting) check may be needed.
interactions.action_zh: 話俾醫生知你有食花旗參。可能需要驗INR（凝血指數）。

sources.label: Yuan et al. Ann Intern Med 2004

interactions.effect_en: Trials found no effect on INR, but one case report found a drop in INR.
interactions.effect_zh: 臨床研究發現對INR（凝血指數）冇影響，但有一個病例報告發現INR下降。
interactions.action_en: Tell your doctor that you take Asian ginseng.
interactions.action_zh: 話俾醫生知你有食人參。

sources.label: Lim et al. Singapore Med J 2018

interactions.effect_en: Bleeding has been seen in case reports, but controlled trials found no significant effect.
interactions.effect_zh: 有病例報告出現出血，但對照研究未有發現明顯影響。
interactions.action_en: Mention it to your doctor. Watch for unusual bruising or bleeding.
interactions.action_zh: 話俾醫生知。留意有冇唔尋常嘅瘀傷或者出血。

sources.label: Lim et al. Singapore Med J 2018

interactions.effect_en: Bleeding has been seen in case reports, but controlled trials found no significant effect, even with aspirin.
interactions.effect_zh: 有病例報告出現出血，但對照研究未有發現明顯影響，就算同阿士匹靈一齊食都係咁。
interactions.action_en: Mention it to your doctor. Watch for unusual bruising or bleeding.
interactions.action_zh: 話俾醫生知。留意有冇唔尋常嘅瘀傷或者出血。

interactions.effect_en: Lowers potassium, which raises the risk of digoxin toxicity.
interactions.effect_zh: 會令鉀質下降，增加地高辛中毒嘅風險。
interactions.why_en: Liquorice makes your kidneys lose potassium, in a similar way to the hormone aldosterone.
interactions.why_zh: 甘草會令腎臟流失鉀質，作用類似荷爾蒙「醛固酮」。
interactions.why_pro_en: Glycyrrhizin breakdown products (glycyrrhetinic acid) inhibit 11β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2 (11β-HSD2), causing aldosterone-like (mineralocorticoid) potassium loss. Hypokalaemia increases the risk of digoxin toxicity.
interactions.action_en: Tell your doctor. A potassium blood test may be needed.
interactions.action_zh: 話俾醫生知。可能需要驗血檢查鉀質水平。

interactions.effect_en: Lowers potassium. This diuretic can also lower potassium, so levels may drop further. Low potassium raises the risk of digoxin toxicity.
interactions.effect_zh: 會令鉀質下降。呢種利尿藥本身都可能令鉀質下降，兩樣一齊可能跌得更低。鉀質過低會增加地高辛中毒嘅風險。
interactions.why_en: Liquorice makes your kidneys lose potassium, in a similar way to the hormone aldosterone.
interactions.why_zh: 甘草會令腎臟流失鉀質，作用類似荷爾蒙「醛固酮」。
interactions.why_pro_en: Glycyrrhizin breakdown products (glycyrrhetinic acid) inhibit 11β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2 (11β-HSD2), causing aldosterone-like (mineralocorticoid) potassium loss, additive to diuretic-induced potassium loss.
interactions.action_en: Tell your doctor. A potassium blood test may be needed.
interactions.action_zh: 話俾醫生知。可能需要驗血檢查鉀質水平。

interactions.effect_en: A hidden extra statin dose, with a risk of muscle, liver and kidney damage.
interactions.effect_zh: 等於額外食多一份他汀類降膽固醇藥，有損害肌肉、肝臟同腎臟嘅風險。
interactions.why_en: Red yeast rice contains monacolin K, which is chemically the same as the statin medicine lovastatin.
interactions.why_zh: 紅麴含有莫納可林K（monacolin K），化學結構同他汀類藥物「洛伐他汀」一模一樣。
interactions.why_pro_en: Monacolin K is structurally identical to lovastatin. Taken with a prescribed statin, it adds further HMG-CoA reductase inhibition and raises the risk of statin adverse effects (myopathy, rhabdomyolysis, liver injury and kidney injury).
interactions.action_en: Do not combine without asking your doctor.
interactions.action_zh: 未問過醫生之前，唔好同時服用。

sources.label: US NIH National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (NCCIH): Red yeast rice
